```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(gptr)
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)

source('R/gpt_functions.R')
```

```{r}
api_key=''
```

```{r}
#x <- read_excel('cv_data.xlsx')
data_location <- 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1mIF3aDXQJOPzfPJqOmbdY4QMsa_asKxsjb7AieAB7xA/edit?usp=sharing'

cv <- list()

cv$entries_data <- googlesheets4::read_sheet(data_location, sheet = "entries", skip = 1, col_types = "c")
cv$skills       <- googlesheets4::read_sheet(data_location, sheet = "language_skills", skip = 1, col_types = "c")
cv$text_blocks  <- googlesheets4::read_sheet(data_location, sheet = "text_blocks", skip = 1, col_types = "c")
cv$contact_info <- googlesheets4::read_sheet(data_location, sheet = "contact_info", skip = 1, col_types = "c")
```


```{r}
description_cols <- c(
  "description_1",
  "description_2",
  "description_3",
  "description_4",
  "description_5"
)

updated_entries <- alter_dataframe_text(
  df = cv$entries_data,
  instruction = "Rewrite the descriptions so they sound more corporate, polished, and professional. Do not invent experience, tools, or metrics. Keep the meaning faithful.",
  text_columns = description_cols,
  model = "gpt-4.1-mini",
  api_key = api_key
)
```


```{r}
cv_new <- list()

cv_new$entries_data <- updated_entries
cv_new$skills   <- cv$skills   
cv_new$text_blocks  <- cv$text_blocks
cv_new$contact_info <- cv$contact_info
```

```{r}
library(googlesheets4)
library(googledrive)
library(writexl)

# Authenticate once per session if needed
gs4_auth()
drive_auth()

# Make sure cv_new is a named list of data frames
cv_new <- list(
  entries = updated_entries,
  skills = cv$skills,
  text_blocks = cv$text_blocks,
  contact_info = cv$contact_info
)

# Optional: sanitize names for sheet/tab names
names(cv_new) <- c("entries", "skills", "text_blocks", "contact_info")

# -----------------------------
# OPTION A: Create Google Sheet directly
# -----------------------------
gs_file <- gs4_create(
  name = "cv_new_reworked",
  sheets = cv_new
)

gs_file
```
